title: K-Way Frontier Merge
summary: Merge multiple already-ordered sources by keeping only each source's current frontier item in a priority queue.
recognition_signals: the output must be globally sorted
only the current item from each input can possibly be the next output
core_rules: Keep at most one active frontier item per input source.
After popping a frontier, advance only the source that produced it.
structural_steps: push the first item from each non-empty source
push the next item from that same source
repeat until the heap is empty

common_confusions.distinction: General priority selection may draw arbitrary changing candidates. K-way merge relies specifically on sorted sources and one frontier per source.
